decision_implication: A Zenodo DOI path requires a public repository, repository-owner access, a GitHub release, and an explicit license.
Zenodo/GitHub integration is an archive option for software records, but it does not replace local creator/license decisions.
CITATION.cff can describe software or dataset citation metadata, but requires authors, version, DOI or URL, and release date.
Use the OSDR study citation button/BibTeX/RIS for upstream data citation and keep NASA OSDR/GeneLab credit visible.
topic: NASA OSDR study citation and credit

decision_implication: Citable metadata needs identifier, creator, title, publisher, publication year, and resource type; placeholder identifier and creator fields block a DOI-ready package.
When a local license is selected, use a standard SPDX identifier or explicit custom-license label instead of ambiguous text.
